reviews.title: Superb design and quality
reviews.comment: This is a beautiful case in all white.  The is more than enough room for just about anything you want to put in there.  Even with a vertically mounted 5070 ti, there is a lot of extra space left over, giving the final result a nice open feel.  That said, it's a large case - make sure you have room for it at close to 13" deep.  There a several things that made this the easiest build I have done.  Aside from the interior size, the dual chambered design makes cabling easy and keeps the front side clean-looking.  Additionally, every bracket, screw hole and snap connection matched up perfectly with overall fit and finish being near-perfect.  I have six intake fans and four exhaust fans, including the AIO cooler for plenty of airflow, though on the down side, the slatted exterior covers probably restrict the airflow to some extent.  One other concern is that it will be a tight fit to get even one low-profile pci card in along with the gpu and pci riser.  Not an issue right now, but possibly in the future.  The case does not come with any fans, though given the range of fan choices and options, included fans probably be not what the user wants anyway.  The case is not inexpensive, but I think worth the cost.  It is heavy also, but built very sturdily.
reviews.author: EricAZ

reviews.title: Love this case!
reviews.comment:
I adore this case! Yes, it's definitely a luxury case as it's pricier than others, but this version does have the 2k screen included. The glass is tempered and I didn't have any issues with it cracking or scratching during the pc build. The bottom compartment does fit three fans, just know you need to fit one inside the case before attaching it to the bracket to make them all fit.
As far as the screen goes, it's a beautiful screen, do note, you need to connect it directly to the motherboard for the picture to work and download the software so you can set your picture/widgets. The cables to hook it up are already ran to the back of the case when it arrives, so you'll just need to hook them up to your motherboard and power supply.
The top of the case does have a compartment that lowers if you want to mount fans or your AIO closer to your motherboard.
Do note, this case includes a PCIe riser 4.0 to connect your GPU to your MOB so the GPU sits upright in the case. IF you need a 5.0 connection like I did, you'll need to purchase the 5.0 riser off Hyte's website, at the time I purchased, they were $99 and you can choose which color you'd like.
The case has plenty of places to route your cables for easy cable management as well as preinstalled Velcro in the bottom to hold some of the cables.
The only downside I saw was needing to buy an updated PCIe riser, I wish they would have had that as an upgrade option at purchase, as well as there being two open spots on the back of the side where you mount the GPU etc. I'm assuming its for easier access, but I do worry about the amount of dust etc that allows into the pc, though I'm sure it's great for airflow.

reviews.title: Premium Case with a Built-In Touchscreen – Still One of the Best After 2 Years
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E15OAZcxEjL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61kkYUGl7UL._SY256.jpg ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – One of the Best Cases I’ve Ever Built In
I’ve had the HYTE Y70 Touch Infinite Dual Chamber ATX Case for about two years now, and honestly, it’s one of the best PC cases I’ve ever built in.
First off, the build experience is incredibly smooth. The dual-chamber design gives you tons of room to work with, making cable management clean and stress-free. Everything feels thoughtfully laid out, so even more complex builds come together easily without feeling cramped.
Compatibility and size are a huge plus. This case easily supports larger GPUs, multiple radiators, and high-end components without any issues. Whether you’re running a high-performance gaming setup or a workstation build, there’s more than enough space to work with.
One of the standout features is the built-in touchscreen, which is honestly amazing. It adds a completely different level of customization and functionality—you can display system stats, animations, or anything you want. It’s not just a gimmick, it actually enhances the overall experience and makes the build feel premium.
Installation overall is very straightforward. Panels come off easily, parts line up well, and the modular design helps speed things up. It’s clear this case was designed with builders in mind.
Price-wise, it’s definitely on the higher end, but after using it for two years, I can say it’s absolutely worth it. The quality, features, and overall experience justify the investment.
Pros:
• Extremely easy and enjoyable to build in
• Spacious with excellent compatibility for high-end parts
• Dual-chamber design keeps everything clean and organized
• Built-in touchscreen is a standout feature and works great
• Premium look and feel
Cons:
• Higher price point, but you get what you pay for
Overall, if you’re looking for a high-end case that combines performance, aesthetics, and innovation, this is a top-tier choice.
